home.search_by_image_desc: Search using an image to find similar styles and patterns in the R355 library. A more targeted way to quickly find what you need.
home.ai_design: As AI technology matures, design becomes smarter and more customized. Training models to generate images drives diversity and innovation in design.
home.album_subtitle: A collection of images covering items, real shots, fabrics, patterns, styles, details, etc., curated into popular themed albums.
home.popular_pattern: With the diversification of menswear design, pattern design has become a key element for expressing personality and style. Patterns are categorized by visual effect and application scenario.

menu.future_intro: By analyzing current fashion trends, multicultural fusion, technological innovation, and consumer behavior, we predict future popular colors, elements, and styles.
menu.trend_intro: Through careful observation and research of current fashion trends, we understand what is trending and capture changes in consumer preferences, helping you better grasp market dynamics.
menu.brand_intro: Aggregating global brand information, including classic styles, seasonal collections, collaborations, and order show pieces, providing inspiration and reference for designers.
menu.market_intro: Capturing popular styles and bestsellers from wholesale markets across the country, giving you real-time market trends.
menu.release_intro: Providing the latest updates from major global fashion weeks, helping you understand runway realities and grasp trend directions.
menu.reading_intro: Deeply understanding fashion trends and industry dynamics through fashion magazines and design books, offering rich inspiration and materials for designers.
menu.pattern_intro: Predicting future trend directions, connecting global inspiration, understanding fashion history, and providing a comprehensive library of artists, muses, and vintage items.
menu.exclusive_intro: Presenting original R355 creations, offering unique and innovative designs, and unlocking future trends.
menu.special_intro: Multi-category, all-around collections of themed items, aimed at conveying creative and design concepts, bringing you cutting-edge item development references.
menu.huixiang_ai_desc: Whether you provide an image or a text description, [HuiXiangZhiTu] AI instantly brings your vision to life — unlocking limitless creativity. Image to image and text to image have never felt this seamless.
menu.smart_wear_ai_desc: Create stunning outfit visuals without a model. Smart virtual try on puts shoes, bags, and jewelry right onto the body in one simple step. Produce high quality images efficiently, save time, and accelerate your marketing.
menu.zhizhan_ai_desc: Get realistic on body results without any model photoshoot. Bring flat laid garments to life, with every detail of the outfit clearly shown — helping you market faster and more effectively.
menu.ai_video_desc: Helping e-commerce merchants quickly generate product video materials, goodbye to model invitations, live shooting, and repeated repair costs, achieving a significant leap in product launch efficiency.
